liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Doll** (1 review): The performance is described as solid and expansive, serving as a highlight [10]
- **On The Road Again** (1 review): First performance in fourteen years, described as a sparkly acoustic journey [14]
- **To Lay Me Down** (1 review): Reviewer gives special mention to the gorgeous performance of this track [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-09-26.144651.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 32 songs; 208 min [1]
- **gd1980-09-26.fob-nak700.ellner-marino.gmb.89536.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 30 songs; 202 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [5]. Said about its sound: Levels are hot in some places; digisnits appear in Brokedown Palace [5]
- **gd80-09-26.acoustic-sbd.hinko.18741.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 9 songs; 47 min; rated 4.5/5 by 8 [8]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is rated good to great, with spot-on vocal performances noted [10]
- **gd1980-09-26.144650.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 32 songs; 208 min [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended all weekend shows, sitting in the fourth row on this specific day [9]
- Reviewer sat in the top balcony row with wife and step-daughter [13]
- Otis Weir wandered around mellowly at the end of the acoustic set [13]
- Otis, Weir's dog, wandered onto the stage during the performance [18]
- Acoustic sets are pure gold, comparable to 1970, with reliable sound now [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-09-26.144651.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII) [1]. Also: Soundboard source supplied patches for Me & My Uncle, Scarlet Begonias, and Black Peter [1]
- **gd1980-09-26.fob-nak700.ellner-marino.gmb.89536.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ron Ellner; transferred by Mike Marino and Bill Koucky; source: Master Cassette > Nakamichi 700s > Sony TC D-5M > Teac Reel to Reel [5]. Also: A cut in Me & My Uncle misses a small amount of music [5]
- **gd80-09-26.acoustic-sbd.hinko.18741.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [8]
- **gd1980-09-26.144650.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII) [2]
